counting_rule: One case per distinct consumer-visible boundary or explicitly review-enumerated condition. Enumerated variants may be sub-results of one case, not multiple coverage counts. NO executable case claims coverage of any of the twenty validator positions/full prefixes. Dummy prefixes that reject before a position do not reach or cover it; V1 SP00-SP19/SP17F/SP19F are retired without replacement. No private-function, source-text, wiring/default or mock-success-echo test remains.

run_rules: No arguments; require -I -B. Nothing at import beyond stdlib imports, constants and definitions. All source loads only in run(), from cap-bounded NOFOLLOW one-link verified bytes, never pathname imports. Bootstrap reader source with a harness-owned anchored read; load all remaining pins via the actual reviewed reader. Plan SHA256 is hard-coded into harness; parent GO pins harness SHA256.

One nonforking process; no subprocess/network/threads/signals/date helper. No wall timestamps inside harness; parent owns /bin/date. Original monotonic deadline=start+300s, checked during module deadline callbacks and after each case, never renewed.

Evidence root is created exclusively at runtime and refused if it exists. RUN/evidence may be created only if absent through an anchored RUN directory fd, otherwise must be a real directory. Every fixture beneath root/fx is created exclusively through retained NOFOLLOW directory fds (O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW), never follows symlinks, never overwrite/unlink/rename/truncate/chmod/utime. Only new hard links/new directory entries or labelled one-byte appends to own RD11 growth fixtures mutate fixtures during cases. All files/FIFOs/links retained.

Never write MOLS39 audit_dir, runs-ext-search-v4 or n1-fault-v1. Record lstat state of these protected paths before/after; change makes exit nonzero. All synthetic record/receipt/result bytes labelled SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE; synthetic dates labelled not_bin_date, never a date reading; synthetic actual_exit is a predicate input, never a measured exit.

REAL_FILESYSTEM uses unmodified reader os namespace. LABELLED_BOUNDARY_FAULT uses a separate namespace of the exact verified reader with os replaced by a delegating proxy, labelled as instrumentation; native operations really occur unless rule says BEFORE; no kernel-evidence claim. Proxy tracks native identities, closes once, refuses double/untracked closes; handles withheld on acquisition exception are identity-checked and closed once by harness. Unknown reader ledger entries remain unresolved even after harness-native cleanup.

Exactly one compact JSON result line per plan case plus one summary on stdout, <=1MiB; no stderr on success. Deferred lines execute nothing and are excluded from MATCH count, but final summary always NOT_QUALIFIED. If deadline/budget stops execution, remaining lines are NOT_RUN. Non-injected BaseException escaping any module: record case line then propagate without substituting success; caller retains original reader. Only harness-labelled InjectedBaseInterrupt may be caught as an expected probe.

Root contains exclusive run-start.json, fixtures, optional retained reader/decision failure reports, and run-summary.json. Bounded bytes are accounted before writes. A result/report exceeding 64KiB is summarized by digest/size, never silently truncated.
